summary: Phase 7 Mega Menu & Navigation Testing - All 12 features verified successfully. Mega menus for Products, Solutions, Technologies, and Tools all open on hover with 120ms delay for stability. Cursor can move into dropdown without menu disappearing. Solutions dropdown shows 8 industry items, Technologies dropdown shows 9 tech items. All menu links correctly navigate to sub-pages and close dropdown after click. Solutions page /solutions shows 8 image cards with gradient overlays linking to /solutions/{id}. Technology page /technology shows 9 image cards linking to /technology/{id}. Mobile menu contains Solutions and Technologies expandable sections with all sub-links. Case Studies and Resources nav links present. Get Quote button visible.
passed_tests: Products mega menu opens on hover and stays stable when cursor moves to items
Solutions mega menu opens on hover, shows 8 industry items with icons
Technologies mega menu opens on hover, shows 9 technology items with icons
Tools mega menu opens on hover and stays stable
All mega menus close when clicking a link
Solutions page /solutions shows image grid with 8 cards
Technology page /technology shows image grid with 9 cards
Mobile menu shows Solutions section with 8 sub-links (retail, corporate, outdoor, events, creative, traffic, immersive, transparent)
Mobile menu shows Technologies section with 9 sub-links (microled, cob-led, mip-led, fine-pitch, all-in-one-dvled, transparent-led, 3d-anamorphic, creative-led, media-facade)
Case Studies nav link present and accessible
Resources nav link present and accessible
Get Quote button visible in navbar
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: DropdownWrap component uses 120ms leave delay via setTimeout for stable hover behavior
GOOD: Gap issue fixed using pt-2 inside absolute dropdown instead of mt-1
GOOD: All dropdown items use proper data-testid attributes (nav-solution-{id}, nav-tech-{id})
GOOD: Both Solutions and TechnologyIndex pages use CdnImage with gradient overlays for visual consistency
MINOR: Console hydration warnings about <span> inside <table> elements on TechnologyPage - appears to be from dev instrumentation, not blocking functionality
